# Investro (DSPS Tech Platform Private Limited)

Investro is a Financial Services company. Investro is a company that provides unclaimed superannuation, deceased estates and companies, unclaimed insurance policies, shares, investments, and bonds. They help individuals and businesses find money owed to them and help them claim it. They take care of the complex submission process and provide a trust account for their clients. Founded in 2016. Headquartered in walsall, United Kingdom, with presence in India.

## About

Investro is the first choice of people wishing to claim money owed to them. Sometimes they don’t even know they have money sitting unclaimed in Government accounts, until we start looking into it.

Investro is here for one reason; to get the huge amounts of money – and we are talking hundreds of billions, around the world, so huge doesn’t even really begin to cover it – back to their rightful owner.
